abstract: Ultrasound examination was performed on 51 patients with clinically pathological scrotum who all underwent surgery. Twenty patients had extratesticular disease and 31 patients had intratesticular disease. The disease was located correctly by ultrasound in all cases. It was, however, not possible to tell a malignant from a benign lesion, or a teratoma from a seminoma. A combination of contact scanning with direct palpation of the lesion and scanning through a water bath or similar "stand-off' arrangement is recommended.
abstract_ja: 陰嚢病変を有し手術を受けた51例に対し、動的および静的超音波検査を実施した。20例は精巣外病変、31例は精巣内病変であった。全例で病変の局在を超音波検査で正しく診断できた。しかし、悪性と良性病変の鑑別、あるいは奇形腫とセミノーマの鑑別はできなかった。接触走査と病変の直接触診、さらに水槽などを用いた離隔走査を組み合わせることを推奨する。
